results.title: 13th International Conference on Space Operations, SpaceOps 2014
results.abstract: The proceedings contain 340 papers. The special focus in this conference is on Space Operations. The topics include: Heterogeneous wireless mesh network technology evaluation for space proximity and surface applications; integrating space communication network capabilities via web portal technologies; Galileo ground segment upgrades and parallel operations in preparation for early service provision; avionics architectures for exploration; extravehicular activity asteroid exploration and sample collection capability; launch vehicle production and operations cost metrics; use of DES modeling for determining launch availability for SLS; space-based reconfigurable software defined radio test bed aboard international space station; wireless sensor networks for planetary exploration; deploying operational multi-satellite control centres on virtual environments; retaining the operational status of a space mission during the loss of the main control system using virtualization; designing an alternate mission operations control room; the future of Columbus operations; exploration technologies for operations; human mars mission surface science operations; a communication architecture for an advanced extravehicular mobile unit; ariane 5 production and integration operations; TDP1 - ground system design and operational experience; mission system operations architecture for an optical communications demonstration on the ISS; cloud computing techniques for space mission design; enabling future low-cost small spacecraft mission concepts using small radioisotope power systems; space weather impacts on spacecraft; nuclear explorations for realizing interplanetary objectives I; adapting a large-scale multi-mission ground system for low-cost cubesats; NASA wallops flight facility-morehead state ground network for small satellite mission operations; development and operation results of cubesat RAIKO using ground network system; middle man concept for in-orbit collision risk mitigation; study the problem of performance evaluation of earth observation satellite mission planning; DEIMOS-2 advanced mission planning capabilities; incorporating the Philae lander within overall rosetta science operations; advanced planning of long temporal intervals during the mission to Saturn; automated scheduling of personnel to staff operations for the mars science laboratory; development of the operation management system for low earth orbit satellite operation and improvement plan for next phase; NASA's spacecraft communication and navigation network integration; exchange and virtualization of a high performance and high availability network; ATV 4 flight operations dependency on a highly reliable ground network; a formal downgrading policy framework for the secure sharing of mission sensitive data and services; web interface and collaboration platform for the ESTRACK management system; modernizing the NASA space network ground systems for centralized management and control of distributed shared resources; a distributed storage architecture for ground network based on HDFS; Columbus cabin heat exchanger dry out during ISS high beta angle phase; launch vehicle control center architectures; NASA space rocket logistics challenges; cost analysis in a multi-mission operations environment; integrated attitude control strategy for the asteroid redirect mission; semantics in space systems architectures; operational considerations for a swarm of cubesat-class spacecraft; operations cost reduction for a Jovian science mission using cubesats; streamlining GDS deployment with the AMMOS automated deployment system; ground systems dependability calculation; statistical Ka-band link analysis; the benefits of packet service in evolving space communications provider networks; evolving the NASA near earth network for the next generation of human spaceflight; international space station operator social training and document management; the new operational system for the control of aerostats; sub-orbital tethered balloon launch system; asteroid redirect crewed mission nominal design and performance; contingency trajectory planning for the asteroid redirect crewed mission; asteroid crewed segment mission lean development; extensibility of human asteroid mission to mars and other destinations; processing a billion of star, an organizational challenge; a ESA nanosatellite for accelerating innovation in satellite control; the near earth object scout spacecraft; planning the GENSO ground station network via an ant colony-based approach; the PICARD scientific mission; digital signal distribution and processing in the NASA space network ground segment sustainment project; updating SLE carrier infrastructure to support evolving operations requirements; validation on modified ranging tone through KOMPSAT-2 satellite; uplink and downlink electronics upgrades for the NASA deep space network aperture enhancement (DAE) project; radially combined solid state high power amplifier for space communications; from contingency to routine operations utilizing a highly configurable mission planning system for mars express; asteroid redirect crewed mission space suit and EVA system architecture trade study; architecting the dawn ceres science plan; a predictive approach to failure estimation and identification for space systems operations; ground segment design for on-orbit servicing missions at GSOC; an automation framework for JPL mission design and navigation; planning the operations for sentinel-1 satellite; EO and SAR constellation imagery collection planning; design of solar thermal thruster for microsatellite orbital control; spacecraft state-of-health (SOH) analysis via data mining; the SMAP dictionary management system; the rejection of interference of LEO ground antenna system inducing mobile communication; an optical communications pathfinder for the next generation tracking and data relay satellite; network monitor and control of disruption-tolerant networks; high performance WebGL for visualization of conjunction analysis; collision avoidance operations in a multi-mission environment; operational reality of collision avoidance manoeuvres; robustness and versatility of the reorbiting strategy for the meteosat second generation satellites fleet; on-comet operations preparation and planning; applying virtualization technology to earth station systems; using AADL to enable MBSE for NASA space mission operations; streamlining operations by sequencing with PIEs; onboard planning and scheduling autonomy within the scope of the firebird mission; space object environment sensor simulator; open source software for mission operations - technology, licensing and community; cyber threat risk assessment of uplink and commanding system for mission operation; highlights of the European ground systems - common core initiative; the common ground system for both satellite ground test and on-orbit operations; orbit prediction for conjunction analysis between KOMPSAT series and space objects; JAC software, dedicated to the analysis of conjunction messages; calculation of operations efficiency factors for mars surface missions; automating the SMAP ground data system to support lights-out operations; advancing autonomous operations for deep space vehicles; benefits of using advanced planning and scheduling technology; mobile control, satellite access through portable devices; a knowledge management tool supporting long term console operations; holistic password management for the ground segment; securing ground data system applications for space operations; a model-based approach to developing your mission operations system; rendezvous and docking strategy for crewed segment of the asteroid redirect mission; dynamics and controls of a generalized frequency domain model flexible rotating spacecraft; mission assurance practices for satellite operations; automation concept for the next generation of CNES command control centers; using real-time collaboration technology to support effective mission operations; planning of automated operations for Galileo early service provision; scheduling as an interoperability service and its security aspects; an effective shift method for multi-satellite operations in KGS; experience and solutions for managing on-board control procedures; surface EVA trade-offs to minimize DCS risk and optimize pre-breathe times; powered swing-by in the elliptic restricted problem; evolving mission control system infrastructure for an altering fleet of spacecraft; system resilience framework and modeling for a cubesat system; EDRS feeder link from Antarctic latitudes - system architecture and operations concept; analytical determination of kepler uplink lock frequency; mission control room conferencing using standard PABX systems; technical and operational investigations of the real-time communication for robotic missions; operations engineering for cross support; security standards for space-terrestrial internetworks; flight-ground integration - the future of operability; a high-performance mission control system based on CCSDS mission operations standards; reconfigurable software for mission operations; small near earth asteroids and gravity assist maneuvers as basic constituents of planetary defense against hazardous sky objects; improved re-entry prediction method using the last-minute motion of re-entering objects; laser com in space, the operational concept; implementing the remote sensing window concept for solar orbiter; the challenges of the bepicolombo simulator development for the flight control team; a common simulation platform to promote models and simulation reuse; an approach for automation the satellite of routine's operation and procedures; using modern methodologies with maintenance software; also foundations need refurbishment - space link services evolution; CCSDS next generation space link protocol (NGSLP).

field_tags.status: officially documented and live fielded contrasts
field_tags.syntax: term WN FIELD; preserve exact caller expression
field_tags.punctuation: colon, equals, slash, period, plus, and underscore are ignored unless protected by braces or double quotes; hyphen behavior is contextual
field_tags.database_scope: the Search codes list is database-selection sensitive; combined selections expose only common fields

boolean_precedence.case: current official documentation says the interface is not case sensitive
boolean_precedence.documented_not_or_equivalence: A OR B NOT C is equivalent to A OR (B NOT C); NOT has higher precedence than OR

fielded_query_interaction.operands: The known accession used AN; the impossible and excluding terms used TI.

boolean_precedence.live_contrast: For both databases, A OR B NOT C and explicit A OR (B NOT C) returned the known accession, while explicit (A OR B) NOT C returned a native zero. The same direction held with the database-specific known AN accession and title C term.
boolean_precedence.known_item_boundary: The live result establishes this fielded contrast, not universal NOT behavior across every field/operator combination.

symbols.?: replace one character anywhere in a word
symbols.*: replace zero or more characters anywhere in a word; at a term ending it is truncation
symbols.$: manual stemming marker when placed before a term

wildcards.limits: at most three wildcard/truncation operators per search term; non-author fields require at least two non-wildcard characters and author fields at least one
wildcards.phrase_support: wildcards/truncation are documented inside exact phrases and with NEAR/ONEAR
wildcards.live_contrast: Compendex nanosatellit* and Inspec COT?-based matched the known record; Compendex C*TS-based and Inspec internal C*TS-based also matched in bounded checks
wildcards.safety: a wildcard-only query is rejected before navigation; malformed source wildcard syntax is an error, never zero

variants_and_exactness.autostemming: Expert default is disabled; the adapter checks the visible Turn autostemming off control and retains it disabled
variants_and_exactness.manual_stemming: $term can opt one term into stemming when the source's documented conditions are met
variants_and_exactness.exactness: double quotes or braces request an exact phrase; quoted/braced terms and author names are excluded from automatic autostemming
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: with autostemming off, the singular title terms matched while unstemmed plural variants did not; a separate owned-tab check with autostemming deliberately enabled matched nanosatellites/interfaces for the same known records
unknowns: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Hyphens can be ignored in ordinary searches but remain significant with wildcard/truncation and in exact AU/FIRSTAU/AF searches; quoted phrases preserve order
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: Compendex low-cost/low cost and Inspec COTS-based/COTS based known-title phrases matched; reversed phrases were native zero

proximity.ONEAR: ordered proximity in the entered direction
proximity.distance: the numeric suffix is the maximum number of indexed words between operands; absent suffix defaults to four
proximity.zero: NEAR/0 and ONEAR/0 mean adjacency; the source recommends exact phrases for precision
proximity.syntax: operands must be immediately adjacent to NEAR/ONEAR; parentheses cannot separate an operand group
proximity.stemming: autostemming is supported; manual stemming requires $ before every term adjacent to the relevant operator
proximity.live_contrast: NEAR/0 accepted both directions for each known adjacent pair; ONEAR/0 accepted only the entered direction

language_and_document_type.language: LA is the document language field; Expert Browse indexes expose Language for both databases
language_and_document_type.document_type: DT describes the source/document type; current rendered native facet values include ca, ja, pp, cp, ds and sometimes ip
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: English known-record clauses were positive and French clauses native zero in both databases; requested native document facets are checked against the live controls
language_and_document_type.boundary: do not treat the current facet codes or RIS TY labels as a permanent exhaustive article taxonomy

dates.range: YYYY-YYYY WN YR is inclusive at both year endpoints; a trailing * or leading * represents an open year bound
dates.ui: the rendered Published control submits source-side yearselect=yearrange/startYear/endYear and echoes the effective YYYY-YYYY range
dates.live_contrast: 1996 versus 1995 for the Compendex known record and 2024 versus 2023 for the Inspec known record
dates.timezone: not applicable: the accepted source-side date contract has year precision and no time-of-day
dates.updates: database update date is a separate UI control and is inactive for this adapter

database_differences.status: officially documented and retained per wrapper

compendex.classification: CL is the Compendex numerical subject hierarchy; official help notes updated descriptions in early 2025 and retained pre-2008 codes
compendex.observed_result_facets: document type order ca, ja, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); Funding sponsor navigator was observed

inspec.observed_result_facets: document type order ja, ca, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); CPC and IPC navigators were observed

database_differences.source_scope: when databases are combined, only fields common to all selected databases are available

time_zone.finding: No publication time or timezone is exposed by the YR field or Published year-range control; the adapter does not invent one.

query_syntax.name: Engineering Village Expert Search syntax
query_syntax.result_facet_clause: {native_code} WN native_field; same-family values use OR

field_tags.status: officially documented and live fielded contrasts
field_tags.syntax: term WN FIELD; preserve exact caller expression
field_tags.punctuation: colon, equals, slash, period, plus, and underscore are ignored unless protected by braces or double quotes; hyphen behavior is contextual
field_tags.database_scope: the Search codes list is database-selection sensitive; combined selections expose only common fields

boolean_precedence.case: current official documentation says the interface is not case sensitive
boolean_precedence.documented_not_or_equivalence: A OR B NOT C is equivalent to A OR (B NOT C); NOT has higher precedence than OR

fielded_query_interaction.operands: The known accession used AN; the impossible and excluding terms used TI.

boolean_precedence.live_contrast: For both databases, A OR B NOT C and explicit A OR (B NOT C) returned the known accession, while explicit (A OR B) NOT C returned a native zero. The same direction held with the database-specific known AN accession and title C term.
boolean_precedence.known_item_boundary: The live result establishes this fielded contrast, not universal NOT behavior across every field/operator combination.

symbols.?: replace one character anywhere in a word
symbols.*: replace zero or more characters anywhere in a word; at a term ending it is truncation
symbols.$: manual stemming marker when placed before a term

wildcards.limits: at most three wildcard/truncation operators per search term; non-author fields require at least two non-wildcard characters and author fields at least one
wildcards.phrase_support: wildcards/truncation are documented inside exact phrases and with NEAR/ONEAR
wildcards.live_contrast: Compendex nanosatellit* and Inspec COT?-based matched the known record; Compendex C*TS-based and Inspec internal C*TS-based also matched in bounded checks
wildcards.safety: a wildcard-only query is rejected before navigation; malformed source wildcard syntax is an error, never zero

variants_and_exactness.autostemming: Expert default is disabled; the adapter checks the visible Turn autostemming off control and retains it disabled
variants_and_exactness.manual_stemming: $term can opt one term into stemming when the source's documented conditions are met
variants_and_exactness.exactness: double quotes or braces request an exact phrase; quoted/braced terms and author names are excluded from automatic autostemming
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: with autostemming off, the singular title terms matched while unstemmed plural variants did not; a separate owned-tab check with autostemming deliberately enabled matched nanosatellites/interfaces for the same known records
unknowns: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Hyphens can be ignored in ordinary searches but remain significant with wildcard/truncation and in exact AU/FIRSTAU/AF searches; quoted phrases preserve order
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: Compendex low-cost/low cost and Inspec COTS-based/COTS based known-title phrases matched; reversed phrases were native zero

proximity.ONEAR: ordered proximity in the entered direction
proximity.distance: the numeric suffix is the maximum number of indexed words between operands; absent suffix defaults to four
proximity.zero: NEAR/0 and ONEAR/0 mean adjacency; the source recommends exact phrases for precision
proximity.syntax: operands must be immediately adjacent to NEAR/ONEAR; parentheses cannot separate an operand group
proximity.stemming: autostemming is supported; manual stemming requires $ before every term adjacent to the relevant operator
proximity.live_contrast: NEAR/0 accepted both directions for each known adjacent pair; ONEAR/0 accepted only the entered direction

language_and_document_type.language: LA is the document language field; Expert Browse indexes expose Language for both databases
language_and_document_type.document_type: DT describes the source/document type; current rendered native facet values include ca, ja, pp, cp, ds and sometimes ip
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: English known-record clauses were positive and French clauses native zero in both databases; requested native document facets are checked against the live controls
language_and_document_type.boundary: do not treat the current facet codes or RIS TY labels as a permanent exhaustive article taxonomy

dates.range: YYYY-YYYY WN YR is inclusive at both year endpoints; a trailing * or leading * represents an open year bound
dates.ui: the rendered Published control submits source-side yearselect=yearrange/startYear/endYear and echoes the effective YYYY-YYYY range
dates.live_contrast: 1996 versus 1995 for the Compendex known record and 2024 versus 2023 for the Inspec known record
dates.timezone: not applicable: the accepted source-side date contract has year precision and no time-of-day
dates.updates: database update date is a separate UI control and is inactive for this adapter

database_differences.status: officially documented and retained per wrapper

compendex.classification: CL is the Compendex numerical subject hierarchy; official help notes updated descriptions in early 2025 and retained pre-2008 codes
compendex.observed_result_facets: document type order ca, ja, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); Funding sponsor navigator was observed

inspec.classification: DI is the five-discipline Inspec classification index; PEC is CPC and PID is IPC; Inspec also documents original/classification and numerical indexes
inspec.observed_result_facets: document type order ja, ca, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); CPC and IPC navigators were observed

database_differences.source_scope: when databases are combined, only fields common to all selected databases are available

time_zone.finding: No publication time or timezone is exposed by the YR field or Published year-range control; the adapter does not invent one.

contrast_fixtures.negative: (1997163539792 WN AN) AND (zzzzzzzzzz WN TI)

contrast_fixtures.negative: (25174812 WN AN) AND (zzzzzzzzzz WN TI)

contrast_fixtures.negative: (1997163539792 WN AN) AND (nanosatellites WN TI)

contrast_fixtures.negative: (1997163539792 WN AN) AND ("nanosatellite low-cost" WN TI)

contrast_fixtures.negative: (1997163539792 WN AN) AND ((development ONEAR/0 nanosatellite) WN TI)
contrast_fixtures.finding: NEAR/0 accepts either order for adjacent terms; ONEAR/0 requires the entered order.

contrast_fixtures.negative: (25174812 WN AN) AND ((board ONEAR/0 interface) WN TI)
contrast_fixtures.finding: NEAR/0 accepts either order for adjacent terms; ONEAR/0 requires the entered order.

unresolved: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

The compound NOT/OR result is live-proven only for the named AN/TI fielded atoms and one stable known item per database; interactions with numeric operators, proximity operators, other fields, or other source routes remain unknown.
Document-type and language vocabulary values are database/context-sensitive; the current native result facets are validated dynamically rather than hard-coded as an exhaustive taxonomy.
YR is year-only and exposes no publication timestamp or time-zone control; timestamp timezone semantics are not applicable to this adapter's source-side date filter.
Spellcheck suggestions and AutoSuggest recommendations are interactive source features, not automatic query expansion and are not silently applied.

field_tags.status: officially documented and live fielded contrasts
field_tags.syntax: term WN FIELD; preserve exact caller expression
field_tags.punctuation: colon, equals, slash, period, plus, and underscore are ignored unless protected by braces or double quotes; hyphen behavior is contextual
field_tags.database_scope: the Search codes list is database-selection sensitive; combined selections expose only common fields

boolean_precedence.case: current official documentation says the interface is not case sensitive
boolean_precedence.documented_not_or_equivalence: A OR B NOT C is equivalent to A OR (B NOT C); NOT has higher precedence than OR

fielded_query_interaction.operands: The known accession used AN; the impossible and excluding terms used TI.

boolean_precedence.live_contrast: For both databases, A OR B NOT C and explicit A OR (B NOT C) returned the known accession, while explicit (A OR B) NOT C returned a native zero. The same direction held with the database-specific known AN accession and title C term.
boolean_precedence.known_item_boundary: The live result establishes this fielded contrast, not universal NOT behavior across every field/operator combination.

symbols.?: replace one character anywhere in a word
symbols.*: replace zero or more characters anywhere in a word; at a term ending it is truncation
symbols.$: manual stemming marker when placed before a term

wildcards.limits: at most three wildcard/truncation operators per search term; non-author fields require at least two non-wildcard characters and author fields at least one
wildcards.phrase_support: wildcards/truncation are documented inside exact phrases and with NEAR/ONEAR
wildcards.live_contrast: Compendex nanosatellit* and Inspec COT?-based matched the known record; Compendex C*TS-based and Inspec internal C*TS-based also matched in bounded checks
wildcards.safety: a wildcard-only query is rejected before navigation; malformed source wildcard syntax is an error, never zero

variants_and_exactness.autostemming: Expert default is disabled; the adapter checks the visible Turn autostemming off control and retains it disabled
variants_and_exactness.manual_stemming: $term can opt one term into stemming when the source's documented conditions are met
variants_and_exactness.exactness: double quotes or braces request an exact phrase; quoted/braced terms and author names are excluded from automatic autostemming
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: with autostemming off, the singular title terms matched while unstemmed plural variants did not; a separate owned-tab check with autostemming deliberately enabled matched nanosatellites/interfaces for the same known records
unknowns: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Hyphens can be ignored in ordinary searches but remain significant with wildcard/truncation and in exact AU/FIRSTAU/AF searches; quoted phrases preserve order
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: Compendex low-cost/low cost and Inspec COTS-based/COTS based known-title phrases matched; reversed phrases were native zero

proximity.ONEAR: ordered proximity in the entered direction
proximity.distance: the numeric suffix is the maximum number of indexed words between operands; absent suffix defaults to four
proximity.zero: NEAR/0 and ONEAR/0 mean adjacency; the source recommends exact phrases for precision
proximity.syntax: operands must be immediately adjacent to NEAR/ONEAR; parentheses cannot separate an operand group
proximity.stemming: autostemming is supported; manual stemming requires $ before every term adjacent to the relevant operator
proximity.live_contrast: NEAR/0 accepted both directions for each known adjacent pair; ONEAR/0 accepted only the entered direction

language_and_document_type.language: LA is the document language field; Expert Browse indexes expose Language for both databases
language_and_document_type.document_type: DT describes the source/document type; current rendered native facet values include ca, ja, pp, cp, ds and sometimes ip
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: English known-record clauses were positive and French clauses native zero in both databases; requested native document facets are checked against the live controls
language_and_document_type.boundary: do not treat the current facet codes or RIS TY labels as a permanent exhaustive article taxonomy

dates.range: YYYY-YYYY WN YR is inclusive at both year endpoints; a trailing * or leading * represents an open year bound
dates.ui: the rendered Published control submits source-side yearselect=yearrange/startYear/endYear and echoes the effective YYYY-YYYY range
dates.live_contrast: 1996 versus 1995 for the Compendex known record and 2024 versus 2023 for the Inspec known record
dates.timezone: not applicable: the accepted source-side date contract has year precision and no time-of-day
dates.updates: database update date is a separate UI control and is inactive for this adapter

database_differences.status: officially documented and retained per wrapper

compendex.classification: CL is the Compendex numerical subject hierarchy; official help notes updated descriptions in early 2025 and retained pre-2008 codes
compendex.observed_result_facets: document type order ca, ja, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); Funding sponsor navigator was observed

inspec.classification: DI is the five-discipline Inspec classification index; PEC is CPC and PID is IPC; Inspec also documents original/classification and numerical indexes
inspec.observed_result_facets: document type order ja, ca, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); CPC and IPC navigators were observed

database_differences.source_scope: when databases are combined, only fields common to all selected databases are available

time_zone.finding: No publication time or timezone is exposed by the YR field or Published year-range control; the adapter does not invent one.

unresolved: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

The compound NOT/OR result is live-proven only for the named AN/TI fielded atoms and one stable known item per database; interactions with numeric operators, proximity operators, other fields, or other source routes remain unknown.
Document-type and language vocabulary values are database/context-sensitive; the current native result facets are validated dynamically rather than hard-coded as an exhaustive taxonomy.
YR is year-only and exposes no publication timestamp or time-zone control; timestamp timezone semantics are not applicable to this adapter's source-side date filter.
Spellcheck suggestions and AutoSuggest recommendations are interactive source features, not automatic query expansion and are not silently applied.

query_syntax.name: Engineering Village Expert Search syntax
query_syntax.result_facet_clause: {native_code} WN native_field; same-family values use OR

field_tags.status: officially documented and live fielded contrasts
field_tags.syntax: term WN FIELD; preserve exact caller expression
field_tags.punctuation: colon, equals, slash, period, plus, and underscore are ignored unless protected by braces or double quotes; hyphen behavior is contextual
field_tags.database_scope: the Search codes list is database-selection sensitive; combined selections expose only common fields

boolean_precedence.case: current official documentation says the interface is not case sensitive
boolean_precedence.documented_not_or_equivalence: A OR B NOT C is equivalent to A OR (B NOT C); NOT has higher precedence than OR

fielded_query_interaction.operands: The known accession used AN; the impossible and excluding terms used TI.

boolean_precedence.live_contrast: For both databases, A OR B NOT C and explicit A OR (B NOT C) returned the known accession, while explicit (A OR B) NOT C returned a native zero. The same direction held with the database-specific known AN accession and title C term.
boolean_precedence.known_item_boundary: The live result establishes this fielded contrast, not universal NOT behavior across every field/operator combination.

symbols.?: replace one character anywhere in a word
symbols.*: replace zero or more characters anywhere in a word; at a term ending it is truncation
symbols.$: manual stemming marker when placed before a term

wildcards.limits: at most three wildcard/truncation operators per search term; non-author fields require at least two non-wildcard characters and author fields at least one
wildcards.phrase_support: wildcards/truncation are documented inside exact phrases and with NEAR/ONEAR
wildcards.live_contrast: Compendex nanosatellit* and Inspec COT?-based matched the known record; Compendex C*TS-based and Inspec internal C*TS-based also matched in bounded checks
wildcards.safety: a wildcard-only query is rejected before navigation; malformed source wildcard syntax is an error, never zero

variants_and_exactness.autostemming: Expert default is disabled; the adapter checks the visible Turn autostemming off control and retains it disabled
variants_and_exactness.manual_stemming: $term can opt one term into stemming when the source's documented conditions are met
variants_and_exactness.exactness: double quotes or braces request an exact phrase; quoted/braced terms and author names are excluded from automatic autostemming
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: with autostemming off, the singular title terms matched while unstemmed plural variants did not; a separate owned-tab check with autostemming deliberately enabled matched nanosatellites/interfaces for the same known records
unknowns: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Hyphens can be ignored in ordinary searches but remain significant with wildcard/truncation and in exact AU/FIRSTAU/AF searches; quoted phrases preserve order
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: Compendex low-cost/low cost and Inspec COTS-based/COTS based known-title phrases matched; reversed phrases were native zero

proximity.ONEAR: ordered proximity in the entered direction
proximity.distance: the numeric suffix is the maximum number of indexed words between operands; absent suffix defaults to four
proximity.zero: NEAR/0 and ONEAR/0 mean adjacency; the source recommends exact phrases for precision
proximity.syntax: operands must be immediately adjacent to NEAR/ONEAR; parentheses cannot separate an operand group
proximity.stemming: autostemming is supported; manual stemming requires $ before every term adjacent to the relevant operator
proximity.live_contrast: NEAR/0 accepted both directions for each known adjacent pair; ONEAR/0 accepted only the entered direction

language_and_document_type.language: LA is the document language field; Expert Browse indexes expose Language for both databases
language_and_document_type.document_type: DT describes the source/document type; current rendered native facet values include ca, ja, pp, cp, ds and sometimes ip
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: English known-record clauses were positive and French clauses native zero in both databases; requested native document facets are checked against the live controls
language_and_document_type.boundary: do not treat the current facet codes or RIS TY labels as a permanent exhaustive article taxonomy

dates.range: YYYY-YYYY WN YR is inclusive at both year endpoints; a trailing * or leading * represents an open year bound
dates.ui: the rendered Published control submits source-side yearselect=yearrange/startYear/endYear and echoes the effective YYYY-YYYY range
dates.live_contrast: 1996 versus 1995 for the Compendex known record and 2024 versus 2023 for the Inspec known record
dates.timezone: not applicable: the accepted source-side date contract has year precision and no time-of-day
dates.updates: database update date is a separate UI control and is inactive for this adapter

database_differences.status: officially documented and retained per wrapper

compendex.classification: CL is the Compendex numerical subject hierarchy; official help notes updated descriptions in early 2025 and retained pre-2008 codes
compendex.observed_result_facets: document type order ca, ja, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); Funding sponsor navigator was observed

inspec.classification: DI is the five-discipline Inspec classification index; PEC is CPC and PID is IPC; Inspec also documents original/classification and numerical indexes
inspec.observed_result_facets: document type order ja, ca, pp, cp, ds (ip appeared after an Open Access refinement); CPC and IPC navigators were observed

database_differences.source_scope: when databases are combined, only fields common to all selected databases are available

time_zone.finding: No publication time or timezone is exposed by the YR field or Published year-range control; the adapter does not invent one.

unresolved: Stemming/variant membership beyond the two tested title fields remains source- and field-controlled; this adapter deliberately fixes Expert autostemming off and does not infer variants.

The compound NOT/OR result is live-proven only for the named AN/TI fielded atoms and one stable known item per database; interactions with numeric operators, proximity operators, other fields, or other source routes remain unknown.
Document-type and language vocabulary values are database/context-sensitive; the current native result facets are validated dynamically rather than hard-coded as an exhaustive taxonomy.
YR is year-only and exposes no publication timestamp or time-zone control; timestamp timezone semantics are not applicable to this adapter's source-side date filter.
Spellcheck suggestions and AutoSuggest recommendations are interactive source features, not automatic query expansion and are not silently applied.
